confirm.description: Add the scale {name}? Readings arrive passively from its advertisements; nothing ever connects to it.

user.title: Add a BLE scale
user.description: Pick a scale that is advertising right now.

address.title: Enter the scale's address
address.description: These scales sleep between weigh-ins and only advertise while someone is standing on them, so nothing may be listed. Enter the Bluetooth address (AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF) to set it up now; entities stay unavailable until the first reading arrives.

people.title: Who uses this scale?
people.description:
Added so far: {count}.

Pick someone Home Assistant already knows and step on the scale — that fills in everything. Add manually only for someone who is not a person in Home Assistant, like a guest.

menu_options.details: Fill in height, age and sex

from_ha.title: Who are you?
from_ha.description: Pick yourself from the people Home Assistant knows about.

weigh.title: Stand on the scale
weigh.description:
Step on the scale, wait for it to settle, then submit — your usual weight is read straight off it, so there is nothing to type.

Scale currently reads: {seen}.

Height, age and sex are the only things the scale cannot measure. Fill them in if you want body fat, muscle and BMI; leave them blank for weight only. You can add them later.

manual.title: Add someone manually
manual.description: For someone who is not a person in Home Assistant. Scale currently reads: {seen}.

error.invalid_address: That is not a Bluetooth address. Expected six hex pairs, like A0:91:61:C8:0B:5D.
error.no_reading: The scale is not broadcasting a weight. Step on it, wait for it to settle, and submit again.

abort.already_configured: This scale is already set up.
abort.not_supported: That device uses the same Bluetooth service as a supported scale, but its readings are in a format this integration does not decode.

weigh.title: Stand on the scale
weigh.description:
Step on the scale, wait for it to settle, then submit. Scale currently reads: {seen}.

Height, age and sex are optional and only affect body composition.

details.title: Body details
details.description: These are the only values the scale cannot measure, and they are what turn a weight into body fat, muscle and BMI. Home Assistant's person entities cannot store them, so they live with this integration.

error.no_reading: The scale is not broadcasting a weight. Step on it, wait for it to settle, and submit again.
